title: Loop of the Recursive Dragon — Computing Concepts, Chapters 10-12: Systems, Security & AI
intro_html:
A free quiz-RPG for an introductory computing course, chapters 10-12: Systems, Security & AI. Battle monsters by answering questions about operating systems, networks, the cloud and the web, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence, machine learning and ethics.

Pick a set below to begin. Your progress is recorded in this course's gradebook.
